LINEFM Radio plays the programmes of the web radio LINEFM and other stations. LINEFM is part of RadioGruppe Deutschland.
The app was developed by Tim Hauke (VectoDE).
We broadcast through the platform laut.fm and hold our own licence for it. The app plays the laut.fm stream and shows the track information provided there. It does not store or copy any music.
Rights to names, logos and covers
Station names and logos belong to their respective operators. Album covers come from Apple (iTunes Search API); the rights to them rest with their respective owners.
